The '''Tranlang IV Communications module''' allowed [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to translate and speak multiple [[Language/Legends|languages]]. [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|Roche's]] [[Siak-series protocol droid]]s were equipped with Tranlang IV Communications modules.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
